summary: Machine-readable execution board for the 72 site. For agents, not people. Each page also embeds its own scoped spec at <script type="application/json" id="agent-spec">. Statuses: pending (do it now) | blocked (needs an input first) | done. Priority: high | med | low.

conventions.membership: Every user is a member. First month free, then $7.20/month. Product is in beta.
conventions.creator_share_rule: INVIOLABLE: creators keep 72%. This is the brand's defining promise (the '72'). Never reduce the creator share below 72% / never raise PLATFORM_FEE_PERCENT above 0.28. Any cost or fee comes from the CALLER's total or the platform's 28%, never from the creator's 72%. Owner's stance: close doors before ever going to 71%.
conventions.branch: Develop on a feature branch, never main.
conventions.secrets_rule: Never commit sk_live_*/sk_test_*. Worker secrets via `wrangler secret put`. pk_* and Buy-Button IDs are safe to commit.
conventions.reuse_first: Scan boneyard/index.json before hand-building any UI.

stack.backend: Cloudflare Worker (service lively-mud-9c4b) served at api.velvetrope2you.com

conventions.twilio_rule: Provision phone numbers in the 772 area code ONLY (on-brand with '72'). Any number search/purchase must filter areaCode=772.

actions.title: Build the /call/<handle> pay-then-room route
actions.do: V1 BUILT: call.html (pay page) + room.html (Jitsi room) + _redirects (/call/* -> call.html) + Worker routes /call-info/<handle> (public) and /create-call-checkout (hosted Checkout, destination charge keeps creator 72%, ephemeral room per call). REMAINING before done: (1) live end-to-end test once the Worker is deployed + a creator has a Connect account, (2) notify/route the CREATOR into the room — currently onCheckoutComplete stores creator.activeRoom but nothing surfaces it to them; add a dashboard 'join active room' cue or a Twilio/email ping. Handle resolution scans KV by username; add a username->id index if volume grows.
actions.verify: Scanning a member QR charges the caller and drops them into a fresh room; the creator can join the same room.

actions.title: Membership billing: weekly → monthly (Stripe-side)
actions.do: The live membership Buy Button's Stripe price shows 'billed weekly' in the checkout small print — it's set to a WEEKLY recurring interval, so members would be charged $7.20 every WEEK instead of monthly (4x too often). Our HTML already says 'billed monthly'; the mismatch is the Stripe price config, not the code. FIX IN STRIPE: edit the membership product's price to recurring MONTHLY ($7.20/mo, keep the 30-day free trial). If the interval can't be edited on an existing price, create a new monthly price + new Buy Button and swap buy_btn_ in paygate.html. Fix before promoting signups — anyone who subscribes now bills weekly.
actions.verify: Buy Button checkout small print reads 'billed monthly'; a test subscription renews monthly.

actions.title: Whitelist expansion + paid access blocks
actions.do: LATER (owner's note): creators get 5 free whitelisted numbers that always ring through; selling additional access as paid blocks/packs is the attention-toll model. Count + lock enforcement MUST live in the Worker/KV, never client-side (a member can reset localStorage).
actions.verify: Creators can grow their whitelist; buyers can purchase expansion blocks; limits enforced server-side.

actions.title: Gate the owner console server-side
actions.do: OWNER_KEY currently sits in client-side source (readable by anyone). Move owner auth to a server-side login/session so no admin key is exposed in the page.
actions.verify: No admin key in page source; owner data requires an authenticated session.
